name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6000 per year to all landholding farmer families in 3 installments of ₹2000 each.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance against natural calamities, pests and diseases. Premium as low as 1.5% for Rabi crops.

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Short-term credit for crop cultivation at subsidized 4% interest rate with additional 3% prompt repayment bonus.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing every 2 years with crop-wise nutrient recommendations for optimal fertilizer use.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
description: Har Khet Ko Paani — 55% subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for water conservation.
